subject: Exec workshop — Bridge provisioning + VIP travel sync
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rivier a Hotel AV <av-support@rivierahotel.com>, Kevin Lawson <kevin.lawson@acme-corp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec workshop — Bridge provisioning + VIP travel sync

Hi all,

We’re finalizing logistics for the September 8 leadership workshop in Riviera Ballroom B. Two quick asks so we can lock vendor SOW and travel logistics:

1) Bridge and AV provisioning: attendees will include a hybrid room (40 in-person + ~12 remote execs). We need a primary SIP-based bridge with a cloud fallback (Zoom Rooms interop). Attached: venue_floor_plan.pdf and bridge_config_sheet.xlsx with room port counts and preferred codec settings. Can Riviera confirm: SIP trunk details (SIP domain, preferred codecs — H.264 baseline + Opus for audio), NAT/public IP for pinning, and a recommended dedicated internet uplink speed? Also confirm an onsite technical contact for day-of troubleshooting.

2) VIP travel and arrival sync: there are 6 VIPs with staggered arrivals between 06:30–11:00 on 9/7. I’ll attach vip_travel_manifest.csv with names, flight ETAs, and dietary flags. We need a secure check-in flow and a private breakout with laptop-only (no shared drives) for sensitive deck review.

Can you please confirm the above by EOD Wednesday (Aug 18)? If you can, propose a test call slot Aug 20 for 10:00 PT so we can validate SIP <-> Zoom interop and keys/cert exchange.

Thanks — short and precise here.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Events & Customer Programs | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0118

Attachments: venue_floor_plan.pdf, bridge_config_sheet.xlsx, vip_travel_manifest.csv

From: Riviera Hotel AV <av-support@rivierahotel.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, Kevin Lawson <kevin.lawson@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — Bridge provisioning + VIP travel sync

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the details — we can support the requested setup. Quick answers:

• Bridge: Primary endpoint will be our on-prem SIP MCU (SIP domain: sip.riviera-hotel.local). We will provide a dedicated public IP and will coordinate with your network team for ACLs. Preferred audio codec: Opus; video: H.264 baseline (we have H.264 SVC on newer gear but will stick to baseline for broader interop).
• Fallback: We can enable Zoom Rooms passthrough on our bridge (we use a cloud connector). We’ll add ZoomRooms Sales on the loop to validate account-level passthrough.
• Bandwidth: Recommend a minimum dedicated uplink of 100 Mbps symmetrical for the ballroom to allow simultaneous gallery + gallery screen sharing.
• Onsite tech: Marco Diaz (marco.diaz@rivierahotel.com) will be your day-of lead; mobile +1 (619) 555-3421.
• Test call: Aug 20 at 10:00 PT works for us — we’ll stage the console and run a 30-minute test (SIP registration, call handoff to cloud fallback, and certificate exchange).

I’ve attached a revised config: Riviera_bridge_config_v2.pdf (includes trunk sample config and recommended SIP timers). One note: our edge router MTU is 1500; if Redwood’s edge uses jumbo frames we’ll need to adjust or enable MSS clamping.

We also have a standard AV SOW for executive events — I’ll share a draft SOW link separately for signature.

Regards,
Marco Diaz
Head AV Operations — Riviera Hotel
av-support@rivierahotel.com

Attachments: Riviera_bridge_config_v2.pdf

From: Kevin Lawson <kevin.lawson@acme-corp.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: marco.diaz@rivierahotel.com
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — Bridge provisioning + VIP travel sync

Monica — thanks for coordinating. A few items from Acme’s side:

• VIPs: Confirmed — we’ll send an updated passenger manifest by Wed EOD. One exec requires a discrete escort and a private room to review an embargoed deck; can we get the breakout room locked down (no room recording, no external storage, and a dedicated point-to-point laptop hookup)?
• Security: We need an out-of-band method to transmit the deck (SFTP or pre-keyed USB to the Riviera concierge). Please advise on the most secure method you prefer.

Happy to join the Aug 20 test if that helps.

—Kevin
Kevin Lawson
Head of IT, Acme Corp
kevin.lawson@acme-corp.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — Bridge provisioning + VIP travel sync

All — tagging security/ops items:

• Markus: can you confirm if the Riviera SOW should include SOC2 evidence and a network attestation? We need hotel-side logging for the bridge and a simple vendor attestation for access to any HSM/KMS if used.
• Travel: attaching vip_travel_manifest.csv (names, flights, ETA, escorts). Please confirm escort assignments and secure pickup windows.
• Communications: we should use a dedicated channel in our private Slack workspace for day-of updates; for the VIP breakout that requires higher assurance, propose a Signal group for the escort + security lead.

Action items:
- Markus to confirm vendor security checklist by Fri (Aug 20)
- Laura to finalize SOW amendments with Marco and send to Monica
- Tessa to confirm VIP room allocation and concierge protocol

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Platform Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachments: vip_travel_manifest.csv

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: marco.diaz@rivierahotel.com, Kevin Lawson <kevin.lawson@acme-corp.com>, enterprise@zoom.com
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — Bridge provisioning + VIP travel sync (Final confirmations)

Team — quick wrap and owners:

• Test call confirmed: Aug 20 10:00 PT (Marco + Zoom + Redwood network team). Marco will provide SIP trunk details during the call; Vivek please share Redwood public IPs ahead of the call.
• Security: Markus will send vendor checklist (SOC2 attestation + logging requirements) by EOD Aug 20. Riviera will supply their edge IP and the MCU cert fingerprint beforehand.
• VIPs & travel: Laura/Tessa — please finalize the escort schedule; Kevin will provide final passenger manifest. Concierge to accept a pre-keyed USB delivered to Marco for the embargoed deck; we’ll avoid cloud transit.
• SOW & signatures: Marco to share the SOW link — Laura, add the amended line item for dedicated uplink and an on-site tech day-of rate. I’ll route the DocuSign link once updated.

Thanks everyone — feel free to reach out in the #exec-workshop Slack channel for day-of comms. I’ll post the final event folder after signatures: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cExecWorkshopAssets

—Monica
Monica Patel
